# sonrai_deploy_account (Data Source)

Resolves which cloud account a root scope's CloudFormation template must be deployed into. This is the delegated admin account where one is configured, and the management account otherwise.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Resolves the account the CloudFormation template deploys into.
data "sonrai_deploy_account" "firewall" {
  root_scope = "aws/r-abcd"
}

output "deploy_target" {
  value = {
    account_id = data.sonrai_deploy_account.firewall.account_id
    delegated  = data.sonrai_deploy_account.firewall.delegated
  }
}

# Point AWS credentials at that account.
provider "aws" {
  region = "us-east-1"

  assume_role {
    role_arn = "arn:aws:iam::${data.sonrai_deploy_account.firewall.account_id}:role/YourDeployRole"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `root_scope` (String) Cloud organization root scope, for example `aws/r-abcd`.

### Read-Only

- `account_id` (String) Account to deploy the template into. Point AWS credentials at this.
- `delegated` (Boolean) True when `account_id` is a delegated admin account rather than the management account.
- `id` (String) Same as `account_id`.
- `management_account_id` (String) The organization's management account. Equal to `account_id` only when `delegated` is false.
- `onboarded` (Boolean) Whether the organization has completed onboarding.
- `organization_id` (String) Cloud-native organization identifier, for example `o-abc123`.
